decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already fully captures the accepted replacement-contract scope, restarted token sequence, and exclusion of old-contract NFT referral identities.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already captures that transfer-linked behavior applies only to replacement-contract NFTs and excludes old-contract NFTs from the active system.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits referral, ticket, and payout reporting to replacement-contract NFTs and excludes legacy-contract reward data.
